changes: Notes expanded only: 'madhya' is more likely Madhu (= Caitra) or a slip for Māgha, and '1213' probably means tithi 12/13 (dvādaśī running into trayodaśī). No change to the data fields.

notes: The era isn't stated, but 'saṃ 955' in a Newari-script manuscript is Nepāla Saṃvat (the catalogue also has NS 955). NS 955 = 1834/35 CE. The month 'madhya' is probably corrupt: most likely Madhu (= Caitra, about March/April 1835) or a slip for Māgha (about January/February 1835). Either way the year is 1835 CE. The tithi '1213' most likely means 12/13, i.e. dvādaśī running into trayodaśī on the same day; it could also be a corrupt figure. The colophon names no persons.
